name: Seaboard Foods of Iowa LLC
old_description: We celebrate America through our commitment to excellence—producing some of the world’s best pork and feeding people around the globe.
about:
Seaboard Foods of Iowa LLC is headquartered in Iowa Falls, Iowa. The company traces its origins to the early 1990s, when it began developing a vertically integrated pork production system that links every stage from farm to table—an approach it calls The Prairie Fresh Way. The business is American-owned and operates as a subsidiary of Seaboard Foods.

The company produces fresh pork under the Prairie Fresh brand, operating one of the industry's newest large-scale processing plants. Its operations span farm management, feed milling, pork processing, transportation, and renewable natural gas production. The integrated system supports production across five states, with facilities in locations such as Guymon, Oklahoma.

Seaboard Foods serves global food markets, supplying pork to retail, foodservice, and export customers worldwide. Its community investments include educational grants across five states and disaster relief through Operation BBQ Relief, reflecting a customer base that spans both commercial and humanitarian channels.

The company differentiates itself through its connected food system, emphasizing animal care, food safety, environmental stewardship, and worker safety—recognized by the Meat Institute in 2025. The Prairie Fresh Way is framed as a commitment to continuous improvement and quality at every step.
